requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: Comprehensive security and compliance features, including Onfido KYC integration, transaction PIN, device binding, real-time login alerts, data encryption, transaction logging, BSA/AML compliance, Reg E compliance, and FDIC insurance disclosure.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Performance and scalability features, including app launch performance, investment portfolio refresh, backend concurrent sessions, and high-throughput notification services.

requirements.title: Card Management
requirements.description: Features related to managing debit cards, including card controls, virtual and physical card issuance, 3D card visualization, and various security controls.

requirements.title: Account Management
requirements.description: Features for managing user accounts, including account dashboard, transaction categorization, search, and merchant information display.

requirements.title: Transaction Processing
requirements.description: Workflow and services for processing transactions, including P2P transfers, FedNow payment settlement, and investment order routing.

requirements.title: Integration and Services
requirements.description: Third-party integrations for banking services, including Plaid for account linking and Apex Clearing for brokerage services.

requirements.title: User Interface and Experience
requirements.description: Features enhancing the user interface and experience, such as P2P transfer amount entry, biometric login process, and real-time price alerts.

requirements.title: Goal-Based Savings
requirements.description: Tools for creating and managing savings goals, including automatic round-up, recurring transfers, interest earned breakdown, and high-yield savings account APY display.

requirements.title: Budget Tracker
requirements.description: A feature to track monthly expenses, with spending summaries and budgeting tools.

requirements.title: Investment Management
requirements.description: Features for managing investment portfolios, including buying fractional stocks/ETFs, automated portfolio rebalancing, and dividend tracking.

requirements.title: Crypto Trading
requirements.description: Ability to buy and sell cryptocurrencies with real-time price alerts and customizable price alerts.

requirements.title: Tax Document Generation
requirements.description: Generation of tax documents (1099-DIV, 1099-B) for tax season.

requirements.title: Digital Account Opening
requirements.description: A 7-step process for new users to open an account, including identity verification, account type selection, and initial funding.

requirements.title: Peer-to-Peer Transfers
requirements.description: Instant transfer workflow between peers, including biometric verification and balance validation, send money to contact, and request money features.
